product: commentary — no product (a funnel-stage format map)
hook: "Best creative formats on Meta for each funnel stage:" — taxonomy promise.
body: Maps formats to funnel: TOF (Founders Ad, UGC, AI Animation, Yapper, Native Statics, Long form VS, Podcasts, 3 reasons why, Voiceless text overlay); MOF (Social media comment reply, Testimonial Mash Up, Raw Honest Review, Review Static, Text Wall Ad); BOF (Urgency Offer Statics, Product Statics).
idea: Review statics are MOF weapons — testimonial mashups, raw honest reviews, review statics, and text walls belong in the consideration stage, not the top of funnel.
why_it_works: Stage-mapping turns a format list into a media plan — the reader doesn't just learn formats, they learn WHERE each one goes, which is the actually useful part.
what_to_steal: LC's funnel map: review statics (verbatim customer reviews) as MOF retargeting for site visitors — not cold.
